g.text: Within and mix depend on grain and cohort

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: Every fixed case. W: within; M: mix. Units: MMBtu/MWh; labels rounded to two decimals.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: Colour shows within on a fixed −1 to +1 scale: pale red (negative), white (zero), pale blue (positive).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: Balanced eligibility uses all seven years. Different matching/aggregation does not identify causality.
